draft.subject: Next step on your Willow Works project
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Following up on my note from last week. Now that your first project is set up, the usual next step is getting your tasks and the people who own them into it -- in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that one step with you and answer anything that's come up so far.

Best,
Chidi
